artworks.title: The Vision of Saint Helena
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a bench or ledge, leaning against one arm with their hand on their forehead. The person is in profile with eyes closed and wearing a cap or headscarf. They are dressed in a loose gown, and in the background, there is a framed picture or window showing an angel flying over a cityscape while holding a cross.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a seated figure in an interior setting. The composition features detailed clothing, armor, expressions, and weapons like spears and a spiked mace. The seated figure appears to be in a position of authority, with a lion and a fantastical creature beneath the throne. A decorative curtain drapes the top right corner, adding to the interior's ornate setting. Strong lines and detailed shading provide depth and texture to the drawing.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene at a well. The image depicts two figures standing by a well, one on each side. The well has detailed stonework patterns on its surface, a large covered roof, and a pulley mechanism with a bucket being held by one of the figures. The environment around the well shows trees and foliage. In the background, there is a distant landscape with a silhouetted castle or tower. The detailed linework and shading bring texture to the scene, emphasizing the features of the clothing worn by the figures and the materials of the well.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a tall standing individual. The scene includes detailed figures, with the central character on the left holding a staff or spear. The background includes a rocky outcrop and trees, giving context to the scene. The style is reminiscent of the works from the Northern Renaissance, suggesting an artist who favored intricate woodcut designs.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical religious scene with figures engaged in a ritual. The illustration depicts a detailed gathering of individuals in a religious setting. A central figure is kneeling on the steps in front of an ornately decorated altar. The scene includes onlookers to the left, dressed in period-appropriate clothing. The woodcut style features detailed shading and line work, emphasizing expressions and postures. The altar is adorned with intricate carvings and possibly shields or heraldic symbols, with an extended candlestick on the left.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: This is a drawing illustrating an execution scene. It depicts a man chained to a large wooden structure surrounded by a group of people. In the foreground, several figures are on horseback, wearing armor and clothing. The man in the center is elevated above the group holding a large cross or pole. Surrounding the group are spears and flags, with a hilly landscape, trees, and a building in the background. The style is reminiscent of a woodcut engraving, showcasing detailed craftsmanship and attention to linear detail.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of knights and onlookers. The scene depicts various figures engaged in or observing an act involving a person tied to a long board or table. The composition features knights in ornate armor holding spears and a setting that suggests a historical event. The drawing is detailed with intricate line work, depicting armor, textiles, and architectural elements like arches and buildings. There is attention to facial expressions and postures, indicating a narrative or significant event. The style is reminiscent of German woodcuts, possibly from the Northern Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene with armored figures on horseback and soldiers. The figures are against a backdrop of clouds, landscape elements, and weaponry. The drawing includes banners, tufts of grass, and undulating ground. The detailed armor and weaponry suggest medieval artwork. Heraldic symbols in the sky hint at noble affiliations or allegiances. The composition conveys a sense of historical narrative and decorum.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Barbara
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing closely together. A woman in a patterned dress kneels in the foreground, with a man nearby wearing ornate clothing and headgear. Other figures around them wear clothing reminiscent of medieval times, some are whispering or gesturing. Some carry weapons. Above them is a large tree with branches extending over the group. The background shows landscapes and symbols.

artworks.title: The Ecstasy of Saint Mary Magdalene
artworks.description: The image shows a central female figure surrounded by small winged figures. The woman is upright with long wavy hair and is depicted in a stylized manner. The winged figures around her are engaging with her, appearing to elevate or support her. In the background, there is a landscape scene with a river, buildings, hills, and two coats of arms. The artwork is a detailed black and white line drawing.

artworks.title: Bookplate of Scheurl and Tucher
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a woman standing upright. She has a calm expression, delicate facial features, and wavy hair with feathers. She wears a long gown with patterns and puffed sleeves. There are decorative symbols around her, including crests with intricate designs and a goat-like creature. The background is plain, and there is an inscription above her in a classical font.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with a robust build. The individual is holding the flayed skin of another person, with hands clasped in front. The person has a distinctive face with facial hair and hair, wearing a halo above their head. They are clothed in a robe, cloak, and sandals. The background features decorative elements like vines and flowers, with an ornate border.

artworks.title: Christ Nailed to the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with multiple figures present. The central figure is being nailed onto a cross by a group of individuals. Some are actively participating while others observe. The intricate image includes various figures in different garments surrounding the central scene. The background is minimal, emphasizing the human interaction. The style resembles detailed woodcut prints from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Christ Raised on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image shows a central figure mounted on a cross, with a sign that reads "INRI" above. Surrounding the cross are individuals engaged in actions like holding ropes and handling tools, seemingly assisting. In the foreground, there is a skull on the ground, and in the background, there are rolling hills and trees. The artwork features detailed line work and textures, capturing movement and emotion in the scene.

artworks.title: Lamentation for Christ
artworks.description: The image shows figures surrounding an emaciated figure lying across the foreground. One figure is cradling the lifeless entity, while others are standing around. One of the figures has a subtle halo. The background shows detailed trees, hills, and a village. The drawing is detailed with linework and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The central figure is depicted on a cross, surrounded by several figures. Above the cross is an inscription "INRI." The background includes a sun and moon with facial features, as well as clouds. To the left, there is a large flower rising above a figure. At the base of the cross, there is a skull and scattered bones. The landscape shows hilly terrain with a distant building. The figures around the cross display various expressions and garments. The use of black ink on a light background creates a stark contrast. This artwork is executed with intricate linework and shading typical of woodcut drawings.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Sebastian
artworks.description: This drawing depicts two figures in a dramatic scene. One figure is clothed in detailed attire with fur trim, aiming a bow and arrow at the other figure who is tied to a tree with ropes. The second figure shows distress, with visible muscles and a pained expression. The background includes trees, structural elements, and scattered pebbles. A sword in a sheath lies next to the archer. The drawing is intricate and expressive in style.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in a scene involving a central figure bound to a stake and four others surrounding. The scene features intricate line work and shading, characteristic of woodcut prints or early engravings. The setting shows a rural landscape in the background with simple foliage and scattered rocks and grass in the foreground. The characters are dressed in period clothing, indicating an older historical setting. The composition and posture of the figures suggest movement and tension, highlighted by detailed expressions and gestures.

artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures with a central platform. The scene is chaotic and intense with figures engaged in a task using tools and a grid-like structure. The style resembles woodcut prints with bold lines and high contrast. The foreground shows figures in dynamic poses around the grid. The background includes architectural elements suggesting a historical or medieval setting.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a horse and celestial figures. The central figure is a horse rearing up with a rider on its back. In the sky above, there are clouds with beams or rays, and above them are several winged figures. The landscape includes rolling hills, a small town in the background, and trees on the left. The composition is detailed, showing movement in the clouds and the horse's muscles, creating a sense of drama.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with a central divine figure among clouds and other figures surrounding. The central figure is depicted sitting on a circular platform, enveloped by swirling clouds and wielding a sword, set within a heavenly context. Other figures, some winged, appear around the central figure, either blowing trumpets or holding various attributes. Below, additional figures are positioned in reverent stances, with expressions suggesting devotion or supplication. The intricate line work and detailed rendering suggest a high level of craftsmanship typical of intricate woodcuts or engravings.

artworks.title: Apostle Judas Thaddeus
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded, elderly man standing with a slight bend. He holds an open book in his left hand and a staff in his right hand, which touches a serpent. He has distinct facial features and long, wavy hair and is wearing a full robe. His feet are visible, and he has a halo around his head with outward lines. In the lower right corner, there is a patch of grass and two serpents. The background is plain, with the initials "HGB" on the right.

artworks.title: Group of Seven Horses
artworks.description: This is a print showing a group of horses in a forest. The horses are depicted in various poses and activities, some grazing on the grass, others laying down, and others standing with their mouths open as if whinnying. The horses have detailed features like flowing manes and muscular bodies. Trees and forest elements are in the background, with a deer visible on the right, and a man looking out from behind a tree in the upper left corner. To the left of center, a monkey is sitting beside a plaque or sign on the ground. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: The Bewitched Groom
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man lying down with a horse observed above. The bottom portion shows a man dressed in ornate clothing, lying down with one arm extended holding a book or document. Above him, a detailed portrayal of a horse in a stable setting is separated by what appears to be a structural support or partition. The horse is depicted in a three-quarter view, showcasing its muscular form. The scene is composed with an emphasis on line work and hatching effects to give depth and texture.
